claims.claim_text: When the off-center distance exceeds one meter, a virtual human intervention is triggered, and the virtual vehicle position and orientation is reset to match the ground truth of the corresponding frame of the original test video.
claims.normalized_text: Virtual human intervention is triggered when off-center distance > 1 meter, resetting vehicle position and orientation to ground truth.
claims.source_quote: When the off-center distance exceeds one meter, a virtual human intervention is triggered, and the virtual vehicle position and orientation is reset to match the ground truth of the corresponding frame of the original test video.

claims.claim_text: In simulation we have the networks provide steering commands in our simulator to an ensemble of prerecorded test routes that correspond to about a total of three hours and 100 miles of driving in Monmouth County, NJ.
claims.normalized_text: Simulation uses networks to provide steering commands on prerecorded test routes totaling ~3 hours and 100 miles in Monmouth County, NJ.
claims.source_quote: In simulation we have the networks provide steering commands in our simulator to an ensemble of prerecorded test routes that correspond to about a total of three hours and 100 miles of driving in Monmouth County, NJ.

claims.claim_text: The test data was taken in diverse lighting and weather conditions and includes highways, local roads, and residential streets.

claims.claim_text: We estimate what percentage of the time the network could drive the car (autonomy). The metric is determined by counting simulated human interventions (see Section 6). These interventions occur when the simulated vehicle departs from the center line by more than one meter.
claims.normalized_text: Autonomy metric is percentage of time network drives without simulated human interventions triggered by >1 meter departure from center line.
